plan.title: bug(vbrief-build): newly emitted xBRIEFs stamped v0.6 instead of current v0.8

narratives.Description: This story implements the cited GitHub issue acceptance criteria in the scoped packages listed in swarm.file_scope. It includes regression tests and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased Fixed or Changed as appropriate.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Every newly generated scope xBRIEF is stamped `vBRIEFInfo.version = "0.6"` even though the current schema version is **0.8**. New artifacts are born on the legacy version.

## Evidence

- `packages/types/src/constants.ts`:
  - `VBRIEF_VERSION = "0.8"` (current)
  - `LEGACY_VBRIEF_VERSION = "0.6"`
  - `ACCEPTED_VBRIEF_VERSIONS = ["0.6", "0.8"]`
  - `contract.test.ts` asserts `VBRIEF_VERSION === "0.8"`.
- `packages/core/src/vbrief-build/constants.ts`:
  - `export const EMITTED_VBRIEF_VERSION = "0.6";`  ← stale
- `EMITTED_VBRIEF_VERSION` is the value written by **all** emit paths: `vbrief-build/build.ts`, `scope/decompose.ts`, `vbrief-build/speckit.ts`, `intake/issue-ingest.ts`, `render/project-render.ts`.

So `task scope:decompose`, spec/interview generation, and issue ingest all produce `version: "0.6"` documents on a repo that is otherwise supposed to be fully on v0.8.

## Impact

- New scope xBRIEFs are inconsistent with the declared current schema (`VBRIEF_VERSION`).
- Mixed-version cohorts when any hand-authored/0.8 artifact sits beside emitted 0.6 ones (surfaced by a reviewer on PR #2317).
- The ~900+ existing scope files are also all `0.6`, so the whole tree is effectively pinned to the legacy version by this constant.

## Suggested fix

1. Point the emitter at the current version: `EMITTED_VBRIEF_VERSION = VBRIEF_VERSION` (import from `@deftai/directive-types`), or delete the local constant and use `VBRIEF_VERSION` directly.
2. Add a migration to bump existing `0.6` artifacts to `0.8` (semantic v0.6->v0.8 transform already referenced by `xbrief-migrate`).
3. Add a test asserting `EMITTED_VBRIEF_VERSION === VBRIEF_VERSION` so this cannot regress.

## Related

- Same constants file still has `PROJECT_DEFINITION_REL_PATH = "vbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json"` (legacy `vbrief/` path) — worth auditing in the same pass.
- Discovered while decomposing #1709 / #1703 into story xBRIEFs (PR #2317).

narrative.Acceptance: Given any emit path using EMITTED_VBRIEF_VERSION, when a new xBRIEF is written, then vBRIEFInfo.version is 0.8.
Given constants tests, when they run, then EMITTED_VBRIEF_VERSION equals VBRIEF_VERSION.
Given the emit constants file, when audited, then PROJECT_DEFINITION_REL_PATH is corrected or documented if still legacy.
